name: Philadelphia 2024–25 regular PSSA district comparison
model_scope: Philadelphia independent 2024–25 grade-school district models use exact NCES LEA 4218990 / PA-126515001 / native AUN 126515001 identities. All 162 audited pure lower profiles with positive October grades 3–8 and explicit-zero grades 9–12 remain searchable and enter separate fixed Math, ELA and independently fitted Combined models. Original regular PSSA All Students / Total published proficiency and Number Scored are matched to each school’s own October individual PIMS low-income ratio. Conditional sampling intervals propagate every model member’s scored-count variance while holding deleted regression scale fixed. Combined uses the maximum positive Math/ELA covariance bound and displays the smaller subject count; this display is not a paired or deduplicated denominator. High, mixed, primary, inactive and unmatched records remain outside the release; Keystone and PASA remain separate.
map_source: School coordinates and district boundaries are unavailable in the audited Philadelphia source release.

income_definition.label: Individual PIMS economic disadvantage
income_definition.definition: October 1, 2024 school individual PIMS Economic Disadvantaged Status Code field 88: own low-income enrollment divided by own same-year total enrollment, including enrolled pre-K/kindergarten categories. TANF, census poor, Medicaid, neglected/delinquent institutions and foster homes are allowed sources; recent reliable FRPL is a fallback. CEP must use individual poverty sources rather than universal meals. Field 131 food-program eligibility is separate. The published proportion truncates to four decimals; the comparison uses the precise original count ratio. Local source choices and reporting coverage remain unknown; no LEA income allocation, another denominator or year is substituted.
